title: Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP) Guideline, Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, November 2020
citation: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago, ICAAP Guideline, November 2020, made under regulation 6 of the Financial Institutions (Capital Adequacy) Regulations, 2020
evidence: The Bank's guideline page https://www.central-bank.org.tt/resources/internal-capital-adequacy-assessment-process-icaap-guideline/ reads 'Posted on November 19, 2020'; the guideline carries 'November 2020' on every page and paragraph 3.1 reads 'This Guideline is made pursuant to regulation 6 of the Financial Institutions (Capital Adequacy) Regulations, 2020.' No commencement clause; the posting date is taken as the issue date. The Bank's two circular letters on the guideline are dated 2020-11-16. Opened 2026-11-05.
notes: Prudential capital guideline, not a disclosure rule: section 2.5 defines climate risk and section 6.3 item E says institutions should embed climate risk in their risk management framework, incorporate a climate risk assessment in the ICAAP and use scenario analysis. It uses 'should'; no public disclosure duty, so F6, not F1. Applies on a consolidated basis to financial holding companies and licensees that are parent companies, and on an individual basis to licensees outside a group (section 3.3). The record is the whole 51-page guideline (table of contents, sections 1 to 11, Appendices 1.A to 1.C) as pdftotext -layout with runs of spaces collapsed and blank lines dropped; the PDF on the Bank's server was modified 2025-09-08 on the Bank page but is the November 2020 text. Row TT-CBTT-ADOPTED passes on Copyright Act Chap. 82:80 s. 7(1)(b) (official administrative text); that reading is for Varun to confirm. English only; no other official language and no translation.

title: Environmental Management Act, Chap. 35:05 (Act No. 3 of 2000)
citation: Environmental Management Act, Chap. 35:05, Act No. 3 of 2000
evidence: Digital Legislative Library page for 'Environmental Management Chap. 35:05' reads 'Year - 2000, Act Number - 3, Commencement Date - Wed, 8 Mar 2000'. Opened 2026-11-05 at https://laws.gov.tt/ttdll-web2/revision/list?offset=0&q=environmental&currentid=930.
notes: The environmental framework act, administered by the Environmental Management Authority (EMA); the page lists 9 versions (2006 Revised Edition consolidations from 31 December 2004 to 31 December 2016, one marked '*Unofficial Update' for 2015, and two Original Act PDFs) and 263 amendments. ema.gov.tt did not resolve (curl exit 6), so no EMA page was read. Link only (GEL-18-08, 2026-11-05): row TT-LAWS-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested (laws.gov.tt: 'unofficial versions of the law', All Rights Reserved; the 2016 edition PDF is stamped UNOFFICIAL VERSION L.R.O.). English is the only language of legislation; nothing to translate. The fetch itself works: curl with User-Agent Mozilla/5.0 returned 200 and a PDF for the 2006 Revised Edition updated to 31 December 2016.
